entries.title: Proverbs 15:1
segments: ¶A soft answer turneth away fury; but a grievous word stirreth up anger.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:2
segments: ¶The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright; but the mouth of the foolish poureth out folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:3
segments: ¶The eyes of Jehovah are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:4
segments: ¶Gentleness of tongue is a tree of life; but crookedness therein is a breaking of the spirit.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:5
segments: ¶A fool despiseth his father's instruction; but he that regardeth reproof becometh prudent.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:6
segments: ¶In the house of a righteous [man] is much treasure; but in the revenue of a wicked [man] is disturbance.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:7
segments: ¶The lips of the wise disperse knowledge, but not so the heart of the foolish.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:8
segments: ¶The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:9
segments: ¶The way of a wicked [man] is an abomination to Jehovah; but him that pursueth righteousness he loveth.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:10
segments: ¶Grievous correction is for him that forsaketh the path; he that hateth reproof shall die.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:11
segments: ¶Sheol and destruction are before Jehovah; how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

entries.title: Proverbs 15:12
segments: ¶A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him; he will not go unto the wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:13
segments: ¶A joyful heart maketh a cheerful countenance; but by sorrow of heart the spirit is broken.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:14
segments: ¶The heart of an intelligent [man] seeketh knowledge; but the mouth of the foolish feedeth on folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:15
segments: ¶All the days of the afflicted are evil; but a cheerful heart is a continual feast.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:16
segments: ¶Better is little with the fear of Jehovah than great store and disquietude therewith.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:17
segments: Better is a meal of herbs where love is, than a fatted ox and hatred therewith.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:18
segments: ¶A furious man stirreth up contention; but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:19
segments: ¶The way of the sluggard is as a hedge of thorns; but the path of the upright is made plain.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:20
segments: ¶A wise son maketh a glad father; but a foolish man despiseth his mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:21
segments: ¶Folly is joy to him that is void of sense; but a man of understanding regulateth his walk.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:22
segments: ¶Without counsel purposes are disappointed; but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:23
segments: ¶A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth; and a word in its season, how good is it!

entries.title: Proverbs 15:24
segments: ¶The path of life is upwards for the wise, that he may depart from Sheol beneath.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:25
segments: ¶Jehovah plucketh up the house of the proud; but he establisheth the boundary of the widow.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:26
segments: ¶The thoughts of the evil [man] are an abomination to Jehovah; but pure words are pleasant.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:27
segments: ¶He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:28
segments: ¶The heart of a righteous [man] studieth to answer; but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:29
segments: ¶Jehovah is far from the wicked; but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:30
segments: ¶That which enlighteneth the eyes rejoiceth the heart; good tidings make the bones fat.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:31
segments: ¶The ear that heareth the reproof of life shall abide among the wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:32
segments: ¶He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul; but he that heareth reproof getteth sense.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:33
segments: ¶The fear of Jehovah is the discipline of wisdom, and before honour [goeth] humility.
